England's History Timeline                                                
                                                                          
Stone Age                                                                 
  7600 BC  o-- Britain's oldest known house was built in Orkney, Scotland 
           |                                                              
  6000 BC  o-- Sea levels rise and Britain becomes an island.             
           |   The people who live here are hunter-gatherers.             
           |                                                              
Bronze Age |                                                              
  2300 BC  o-- People arrive from Europe and settle in Britain.           
           |   They bring farming and metalworking.                       
           +-- New styles of pottery and ways of burying the dead appear. 
           |                                                              
  2200 BC  o-- The last major building works are completed at Stonehenge. 
           |   People now bury their dead in stone circles.               
           +-- The first metal objects are made in Britain.Some other nice
               things happen. it is a good time to be alive.
